title: Shared lawyers and law firms across the deals
summary: Several lawyers and firms do recur across the Trump-family ventures, their counterparties and the government, and most individual ties are documented in filings or multiple outlets: Teresa Goody Guillen spoke for World Liberty Financial to Congress while registered as a Binance/CZ lobbyist; Paul Hastings is simultaneously the Trump sons' SPAC counsel, home of Aryam/G42's WLF board designee Martin Edelman, and home of Brad Bondi, brother of then-AG Pam Bondi (who left DOJ on Apr 2, 2026; Todd Blanche was acting AG, then Senate-confirmed 50-49 on Aug 8, 2026 and sworn in Aug 10, 2026); Dhillon Law Group produced the White House counsel who signs ethics waivers and (per one source) the registrant of the inaugural committee and the library fund; Bondi lobbied for Qatar before signing the jet memo; Blanche and Mizelle moved from Trump/Kushner private counsel to top DOJ posts. What is not shown is coordination or improper influence: firm-level overlaps are our own cross-referencing, several links (Edelman-Witkoff friendship, Edelman on the Board of Peace, Roth at Dhillon, Goody Guillen for Justin Sun) rest on single sources, and the people involved deny wrongdoing.

sub_claims.statement: Teresa Goody Guillen (BakerHostetler) represented World Liberty Financial before Congress while registered as a lobbyist for Binance and Changpeng Zhao, the counterparty in WLF's biggest deal.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. A Senate Banking minority document cites a May 29, 2025 letter from Goody Guillen and fellow BakerHostetler partner Jonathan R. Barr 'on behalf of World Liberty Financial, Inc.' answering Sens. Warren and Merkley's May 14, 2025 questions about MGX's $2B Binance investment being settled in WLF's USD1. In the same period Binance and Zhao had registered her as a lobbyist (Bloomberg Law: registration in late March 2025; disclosures show about $290K paid in 2025, see C36/C49). After the pardon, she wrote to Warren on Zhao's behalf on Oct 28, 2025 demanding a retraction of Warren's post-pardon statements (The Block); the Nov 2, 2025 'Response re Changpeng Zhao' document published by Punchbowl appears, per search coverage, to be the reply from Warren's counsel rejecting that demand (audit correction; the PDF could not be read directly). So one lawyer spoke for both WLF and Binance/CZ on the deal Congress was asking about, and then on the CZ pardon (Oct 23, 2025). This shows overlapping representation, not that she arranged a quid pro quo; she calls pay-to-play claims false and disputes that WLF is 'Trump's company'. Audit note: Legis1 (single-source) reports she ended the Binance/Zhao representation at BakerHostetler in July 2025 and moved to Bellementis; that conflicts with later coverage still placing her at BakerHostetler and is unresolved.

sub_claims.statement: Goody Guillen was on the Trump transition's shortlist for SEC chair and also took Justin Sun as a client.
sub_claims.finding: SEC shortlist: DOCUMENTED (CoinDesk, Nov 19, 2024, widely relayed; she served in the SEC's Office of the General Counsel 2009-2011; Paul Atkins got the job and she publicly backed him). Justin Sun: SINGLE-SOURCE. Molly White wrote in Sept 2025 that Sun hired her for his lawsuit against Bloomberg; we did not find a docket or second outlet. If accurate, the same lawyer touched WLF, Binance/CZ and WLF's largest early token buyer (Sun, C05).

sub_claims.statement: Paul Hastings sits on three separate Trump-adjacent tracks: issuer's counsel to the Trump sons' SPAC, home firm of Aryam/G42 signatory Martin Edelman, and home firm of Brad Bondi.
sub_claims.finding: Each engagement is DOCUMENTED; the pattern is INFERRED. (a) New America Acquisition I's S-1 (Aug 4, 2025) lists Paul Hastings as company counsel; the firm called the 'public policy tailwinds' sentence a scrivener's error (C27); the IPO closed Dec 5, 2025 at $345M, Paul Hastings again company counsel. (b) Martin Edelman is Of Counsel at Paul Hastings (Chambers 2026), G42's general counsel and a long-time adviser to the Abu Dhabi ruling family; he and G42 CEO Peng Xiao took Aryam's two WLF board seats after the Jan 2025 $500M/49% deal (C06, C57). (c) Brad Bondi, brother of then-AG Pam Bondi, joined Paul Hastings in Nov 2024 from Cahill Gordon & Reindel (Lawdragon, 2024-11-13) and co-chairs Paul Hastings' investigations/white-collar practice. No source connects these engagements to each other. Paul Hastings is a firm of well over a thousand lawyers, so shared employer alone shows nothing about coordination; it is listed because a reader of any one story would not see it. Audit note: Law360 (Aug 4, 2025) says the SPAC filed 'with guidance from Paul Hastings LLP and Holland & Knight LLP', so Paul Hastings was one of two firms on the deal.

sub_claims.statement: Brad Bondi's clients benefited from pardons and DOJ/SEC dismissals while his sister ran DOJ.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED facts, contested inference. Brad Bondi was lead trial counsel for Trevor Milton (Nikola), who with his wife gave about $1.8M to pro-Trump causes before the 2024 election, was pardoned in March 2025, and whose SEC civil case was dismissed with prejudice in Sept 2025 without explanation. On Mar 11, 2026 Sen. Schiff and Rep. Min (with 10 colleagues) asked the DOJ OIG to examine whether Pam Bondi recused from four matters involving his clients (Milton; dismissal of charges against ex-Florida Rep. Carolina Amesty; withdrawal of the case against developer Sid Chakraverty; an SEC matter involving Mehr); a Dec 16, 2025 letter got no reply. DOJ: decisions 'were made through the proper channels, and the Attorney General had no role in them.' Brad Bondi and Paul Hastings did not comment. No OIG finding was found. Favourable outcomes are not proof of influence. Audit note: Bondi led Milton's 2021-22 criminal defence while a partner at Cahill Gordon & Reindel (Law.com, Business Wire, 2021); he joined Paul Hastings only in Nov 2024, so the Milton engagement predates his Paul Hastings tenure.

sub_claims.statement: Martin Edelman links the Aryam/WLF deal to Steve Witkoff personally and to the administration's Gaza structure.
sub_claims.finding: Witkoff friendship: SINGLE-SOURCE (Bloomberg Law profile, May 2025: the two befriended each other in 1980s-90s New York real estate; Witkoff calls him trusted 'across different cultures'). The Witkoff family was a beneficiary of the Aryam deal Edelman helped execute (at least $31M of the $250M upfront went to Witkoff-linked entities, C14) - the co-occurrence is DOCUMENTED, but no source says the friendship shaped the deal. UAE Order of the Union, June 2026: single outlet (Jewish Insider). Gaza 'Board of Peace' executive board: SINGLE-SOURCE (a leaked draft resolution reported by Drop Site News names Edelman and Susie Wiles as two additional members; the White House's Jan 16, 2026 list of seven did not include him). Witkoff and Kushner are on that board, so if accurate Edelman would sit beside the envoy whose family profited from the deal he signed for Aryam - unverified.

sub_claims.statement: Dhillon Law Group is a common origin for the White House counsel who signs ethics waivers and the lawyer who incorporated the inaugural committee and the library fund that received settlement money.
sub_claims.finding: David Warrington: DOCUMENTED. Partner at Dhillon Law Group 6/2021-1/2025 (his OGE disclosure), Trump campaign general counsel, named White House counsel Dec 4, 2024. ProPublica's summary of his disclosure lists Donald J. Trump, Save America, the 2024 campaign and Trump Vance 2025 Transition as firm clients and a ~$1.2M salary; ProPublica also shows officer roles at Trump Vance Inaugural Committee Inc. for Dhillon partners (Warrington as director per the summary we saw; the page could not be read directly). Yahoo reports the firm took in more than $13M from Trump-related work. As counsel he issued the Mar 5, 2025 waiver letting David Sacks keep Craft crypto stakes (C34) and told CNN Witkoff had divested from WLF (C14). Jacob Roth: SINGLE-SOURCE for the firm tie. OpenSecrets (via IBTimes) says Roth, 'with the Dhillon Law Group' as of 2025, incorporated the Trump-Vance inauguration committee in Nov 2024 and the Trump Presidential Library Fund on Dec 20, 2024 - the fund created days after ABC agreed to its $15M. Roth: 'my job is simply to be the registrant.' Firm founder Harmeet Dhillon became Assistant AG for Civil Rights (OGE ethics agreement). This is a documented professional network; it does not show that ethics decisions or entity filings were improper.

sub_claims.statement: Alejandro Brito's firm holds the ABC settlement money and is paid by Trump's PAC to sue other media companies.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. ABC's response to Sen. Warren says its parent wired the settlement on Dec 19, 2024 to the 'Brito Law, PLLC Trust Account', the escrow established by plaintiff's counsel; in 2026 ABC said the $15M was still there (C33). FEC records show Save America paid Brito's firm nearly $300K in 2025 for 'legal consulting' (Florida Bulldog), and later reports show the PAC owing the firm money (figures vary). Brito represents Trump against the NYT, WSJ, the BBC and JPMorgan/Jamie Dimon. Save America also paid Dhillon Law Group and Sullivan & Cromwell (Bloomberg Government). The CBS/Paramount $16M settlement was handled by a different Trump lawyer (Edward Paltzik), not Brito. The chain ABC -> Brito escrow -> intended library fund (registered by Roth) is documented; where the money ultimately goes remains unverified.

sub_claims.statement: James Kiley, a former Trump personal lawyer, is a trustee of the library foundation that is to receive the Qatari 747 and the Miami land.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. The Donald J. Trump Presidential Library Foundation (incorporated May 2025, address at Trump National Jupiter) lists Eric Trump, Michael Boulos (Tiffany Trump's husband) and James Kiley, a Long Island attorney who represented Trump in 2020-2022, as trustees (CBS, InfluenceWatch; C48). The foundation took title to the Miami Dade College parcel and is slated to receive the Qatari jet by 2029 (C16, C48). Kiley's own role beyond trustee was not found.

sub_claims.statement: Pam Bondi was a registered foreign agent for Qatar before, as Attorney General, signing the memo that cleared the Qatari jet gift.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. Bondi was listed under FARA as a lobbyist for the Embassy of Qatar at Ballard Partners in 2019-2020; Ballard (not Bondi personally) was paid $115K a month (fact check of DOJ filings). As AG she signed a DOJ memo concluding acceptance of the Qatari 747 for the Air Force and later the library foundation was legally permissible (OLC reportedly approved it first). DOJ says career ethics officials found no conflict; Sen. Durbin says she had 'a clear conflict of interest'. The memo has not been released; American Oversight sued for it on behalf of the Freedom of the Press Foundation (July 2025). Ballard, where Susie Wiles also worked, later signed Kraken and Blockchain.com (C52). The record shows a prior paid relationship and a later official decision; it does not show the decision was wrong. Audit note: per ABC News sources (relayed by Yahoo/CNN; anonymous, so single-source on this point), the memo was addressed to White House counsel David Warrington's office at his request, so the Qatar-jet clearance ran between the ex-Qatar lobbyist AG and the ex-Dhillon partner (item above). Bondi left office on Apr 2, 2026.

sub_claims.statement: Todd Blanche went from Trump's criminal defence lawyer to the DOJ official who dismantled crypto enforcement while holding crypto.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. Blanche (Blanche Law Group) defended Trump in the criminal cases, then as Deputy AG signed the Apr 7, 2025 memo disbanding the NCET - the unit that led the Binance case (C36). ProPublica: he then held about $158K-$470K in bitcoin and ether plus other tokens and Coinbase stock, began selling only in late May, and divested partly by transferring holdings to adult children and a grandchild. The Campaign Legal Center asked the DOJ OIG (Jan 2026) to examine a possible 18 U.S.C. 208 violation; six Democratic senators pressed him. CNN reported he was advised in March 2025 to recuse from Trump matters. DOJ says actions were 'appropriately flagged, addressed and cleared in advance'. He became acting Attorney General when Trump announced Bondi's departure on Apr 2, 2026, and was confirmed by the Senate 50-49 on Aug 8, 2026, with Republicans Collins and Murkowski voting no, and was sworn in on Aug 10, 2026 (Axios, NOTUS) (C49). When he and Emil Bove went to DOJ, Trump replaced them on the hush-money appeal with Sullivan & Cromwell (Robert Giuffra), which Trump's PAC also paid.

sub_claims.statement: Chad Mizelle moved from Kushner's Affinity Partners to DOJ chief of staff and back to representing Kushner.
sub_claims.finding: DOCUMENTED. Bloomberg (Jan 2022) reported Affinity hired Mizelle, a former associate counsel to the president; Florida Bulldog and others describe him as Affinity's chief legal officer before he became DOJ chief of staff under Bondi in Jan 2025. He left DOJ around Sept 24, 2025 (Axios, Bloomberg Law). By Oct 2026 he was Kushner's lawyer, calling CREW's Oct 14, 2026 suit (D.D.C. 26-cv-3580) over Kushner's envoy role 'without merit' (C15) and threatening Conde Nast over the Cole book excerpt (C37, C46). No source alleges he handled any Kushner- or Affinity-related matter at DOJ; the revolving door itself is the documented point.

sub_claims.statement: Clare Locke and Sullivan & Cromwell recur across the deals.
sub_claims.finding: Clare Locke: DOCUMENTED only as David Sacks's defamation counsel in his dispute with the NYT (C34); we found no other Trump-family or counterparty engagement. Sullivan & Cromwell: DOCUMENTED as Trump's appellate counsel (hush-money and NY civil-fraud appeals) and as a recipient of Trump PAC money; we found no coverage of S&C acting for WLF, Binance, Aryam/MGX or other counterparties in this project. Neither firm is shown to be a cross-deal connector.

corrections: The claim implies Paul Hastings' SPAC role and Edelman are linked; they are separate engagements at a very large firm and no source connects them.
The CBS/Paramount $16M settlement was handled by Trump lawyer Edward Paltzik, not Alejandro Brito; Brito's firm holds the ABC escrow.
Pam Bondi is no longer Attorney General; Todd Blanche became acting AG and then AG in 2026 (C49).
Chad Mizelle was DOJ chief of staff from Jan to about Sept 24, 2025; his Kushner/Affinity role predates DOJ and his work as Kushner's personal counsel postdates it.
Ballard Partners, not Bondi personally, was paid $115K a month by Qatar.
Audit: Goody Guillen's letter for Zhao was dated Oct 28, 2025; the Nov 2, 2025 document is reported as Warren's counsel's reply, not her letter.
Audit: Bondi left as AG on Apr 2, 2026; Blanche was acting AG, then confirmed Aug 8, 2026 (50-49) and sworn in Aug 10, 2026.
Audit: Brad Bondi represented Milton while at Cahill Gordon; he joined Paul Hastings in Nov 2024.
denials_and_context: Goody Guillen calls the pay-to-play claims false and disputes that WLF is Trump's company.
DOJ says Pam Bondi had no role in decisions on her brother's clients and that career ethics officials found no conflict in her signing the Qatar jet memo.
DOJ says Blanche's crypto-related actions were flagged, addressed and cleared in advance.
Jacob Roth: 'my job is simply to be the registrant.'
Mizelle calls the CREW suit against Kushner without merit; no source alleges he handled Kushner matters at DOJ.
WLF and the White House say Trump and Witkoff were not involved in the Aryam deal.
Repeat use of trusted lawyers is common for any family business and administration; documented ties show networks, not wrongdoing.
